subject: Tenant custodianship & access lineage evidence - FinHealth intake
messages:
From: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@finhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: FinHealth SOC2 Audit Team <audit-team@finhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Tenant custodianship + SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of FinHealth's SOC 2 intake we need artifacts showing tenant-level access ownership and provisioning evidence for the Redwood account. Specifically we need the following by end-of-day Wednesday (Aug 23):

- A snapshot of the current access roster for the FinHealth tenant (owner, role, created_at) — CSV format is fine.
- SCIM delta sample covering the last 30 days (create/update/delete events) with column headers and a short readme describing hashing/redaction applied.
- A handful (3-5) of raw SAML assertion examples for successful logins into the tenant (redact PII — name identifiers hashed).
- Short mapping that ties these artifacts to SOC 2 / SIG control IDs (or a pointer to where you map them).

If you can provide a secure download (pre-signed S3 or enterprise SharePoint/Dropbox) and a short note on redaction approach that would be ideal. If you need extra time, please flag it now — our window is tight but flexible by 48 hours with notice.

Thanks,
Maria Ortiz
Senior IT Auditor | FinHealth
maria.ortiz@finhealth.com

Attachment: finhealth_artifact_template.xlsx (see columns)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@finhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Tenant custodianship + SSO/SCIM evidence for SOC 2 intake

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the requested artifacts by Wed EOD. Quick plan and owners below:

- Access roster snapshot (CSV) — owner: Jasmine Liu. We'll include columns: user_id (hashed), email (redacted), role, owner_of_record, created_at, last_active.
- SCIM delta sample (30d) — owner: Karthik Iyer. We will provide a CSV with event_type, timestamp, resource_type, resource_id(hashed), changes, source (API/bulk).
- SAML assertion examples — Karthik will extract 3 successful assertions with identifiers hashed and timestamps preserved.
- SOC 2 / SIG mapping — I'll produce a 1-page mapping doc tying artifacts to control IDs (CC6, AC-1 etc.) and link to our internal evidence index.

Delivery mechanism: secure S3 bucket with pre-signed keys (expires 7 days) + HubSpot record for tracking. If FinHealth prefers an alternative (SFTP/SharePoint), we can do that — please confirm.

I'll loop Karthik and Jasmine for technical and redaction details.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Customer Security Operations | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0123

Hi Maria / Sergio — attaching technical notes and pointer to the sample extracts. Summary below:

SCIM delta sample (scim_delta_sample.csv): columns = [event_type, event_timestamp, resource_type, resource_id_hash, attribute_changes, source, request_id]. We will hash resource_id using sha256(salt + id) and include the salt name in a separate readme (salt stored in our secrets vault; we will not share the raw salt). The CSV in S3 will include the readme scim_readme.txt explaining hashing and lineage.

SAML assertions (saml_assertion_examples.txt): we will capture the Assertion element for 3 successful auths (AuthnInstant preserved). NameID will be replaced with hashed identifier and IP addresses redacted. We will not share user-display names or emails in the assertions.

Access roster snapshot (access_roster_snapshot.csv): columns = [user_id_hash, assigned_role, owner_of_record, created_at, last_seen, provisioning_source]. Owner_of_record maps to our internal role stewardship table.

Delivery link (pre-signed S3): https://s3-presigned.example/redwood-evidence/finhealth/2028-08-19/ (link expires 7 days).

Related artifacts uploaded: scim_delta_sample.csv, saml_assertion_examples.txt, access_roster_snapshot.csv, scim_readme.txt, control_mapping_finhealth.pdf.

Notes on redaction: We will never expose raw PII. If FinHealth requires name/email mapping for specific control testing, we can provide a redaction-controlled repository under NDA and with auditor access logs.

- Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
